This plan misses 7 (episode, follower) pairs, all of them Ines on The Glass Meridian episodes 4–10. Every other episode is caught in time by every follower. It costs **$191.86** (19,186 cents) across 10 paid periods. I did not prove 7 is the minimum by exhaustive search, but every alternative I tried missed the same number or more.

**Why the limit of 2 forces some misses**

- Tidewell has to be on almost continuously from Dec 23 to Mar 12. Sami's 2‑day windows for The Copper Circuit fall every week, and this one service covers 50 pairs.
- That leaves one other slot for that whole stretch. Marquee, Pebble Kids (The Paper Harbor, Jan 20–22) and Orbit (The Hollow Garden, from Jan 24) all compete for it.
- The best arrangement in that slot is:
  - Marquee from Nov 26 to Dec 26, catching Glass Meridian episodes 1–3.
  - Pebble Kids from Dec 26 to Jan 26, catching all of Paper Harbor.
  - Orbit from Jan 26, catching every Hollow Garden episode for both followers.
- Alternatives I checked missed 8 to 17 pairs. These included keeping Marquee longer, skipping Pebble Kids, starting Orbit later, or briefly turning Tidewell off to make room.

**Schedule (end dates exclusive)**

| Service | Access | Covers |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel+ | Nov 13 – Dec 13 | The Salt Garden (Dana, Sami on Dec 12) |
| Marquee | Nov 26 – Dec 26 | The Glass Meridian episodes 1–3 |
| Tidewell | Dec 23 – Mar 23 (3 periods) | Crooked Ferry, The Copper Circuit, The Paper Orchard |
| Pebble Kids | Dec 26 – Jan 26 | The Paper Harbor |
| Orbit | Jan 26 – Feb 26, then Mar 2 – Apr 2 | The Hollow Garden. The Feb 26–Mar 1 gap misses no viewing window, so a third period isn't needed. |
| Pebble Kids | Mar 23 – Apr 23 | The Glass Circuit (Ines) |
| Kestrel+ | Apr 2 – May 2 | The Copper Meridian (Dana's window runs to Apr 10) |

No day has more than two non-required services active. No periods of the same service overlap. Every period starts within the plan dates. Lumen covers no followed title, so it is not used.

**Cost:** Kestrel+ 2 × 1,799 + Marquee 1,399 + Tidewell 3 × 899 + Pebble Kids 2 × 799 + Orbit 2 × 1,099 = 19,186 cents.
